notes.title: Release 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Forgotten Tomb Release[/h1]

Today we released the 'Forgotten Tomb' level of the game! This level is themed in an Ancient Egyptian tomb, make your way through solving puzzles made of light, falling pits and more!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/be7b0d_949b2bdae9364532b47d54809847884d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1358,h_764,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/be7b0d_949b2bdae9364532b47d54809847884d~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/be7b0d_19addd19976746d2a743e11025027486~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1358,h_764,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/be7b0d_19addd19976746d2a743e11025027486~mv2.webp[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/be7b0d_92f2b0b0f3e44c8c94dd75a4a2852b92~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1358,h_764,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/be7b0d_92f2b0b0f3e44c8c94dd75a4a2852b92~mv2.webp[/img]

[h1]Settings Menu[/h1]

In this update we included a Settings menu. The menu can be accessed by pressing the 'Menu' button on your controller. Using this menu you can modify:
[list]
[*] - Audio Settings; change the volume of, or mute different sound channels of the game
[*] - Graphics Settings; change some of the graphic settings of the game to improve performance
[*] - General Settings; turn off the hints in the levels as well as restarting the tutorial in case you need a refresher
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] - Released 'Forgotten Tomb'
[*] - Implemented Settings Menu
[*] - Added hand models to all levels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.content: In this update, we replaced the UV torch with the new Geiger Counter. Unfortunately, whilst it was cool, the UV torch didn't seem to work on the fuel shader outside of the development environment. We also fixed a couple of small bugs relating to the Hint System.
